public.title: 1. Public (anonymous)
public.cond: uadebate.com, the federation's site, in English for now, in cab's look, with no sign-in of its own. Everyone sees these pages, signed in or not: a person signed in on cab without a site role sees exactly the same. One header on every page: the UAdebates wordmark in Cedarville Cursive, Home, News, Calendar, Clubs, About, the language slot and Cabinet, a plain link to cab. One footer: the site pages, cab with its Policy and Terms, and the federation's real addresses (ngo.dfu@ and support@uadebate.com, Telegram). cab's tokens light and dark; at most one gold action per page; no middle dots, no arrows. The calendar is mostly tournaments and shows public events only. About carries the history ported from the Wix About page.

content-manager.title: 2. Content manager
content-manager.cond: All public pages + Edit site, behind the content-manager ribbon: news, the calendar and the club directory. Entry is by a link the admin gives, uadebate.com/manage; the person signs in on cab (cab's sign-in, the session shared across *.uadebate.com by deploy config). Every /manage address answers 404 to anyone without the role, signed out included, so the public never learns editing exists, and nothing in cab links here. The role lives in uadebate's own table, keyed by the cab account id; cab roles do not grant it and it is not a cab admin. The calendar shows private events too, each with a Public / Private switch; private events never leave this column. Forms follow cab's: the command sits in the bar, one gold action.

admin.title: 3. Admin
admin.cond: All content-manager pages + People: grant and revoke the content-manager role for cab accounts. An admin here is a cab admin: uadebate reads cab's is_admin downward and never writes to cab. Nothing in cab knows about this page.

phoenix-api.title: 4. Phoenix API, /api/v1 (uadebate.com)
phoenix-api.cond: Every page verb above maps to one of these, with the same ladder: public reads for everyone; everything under /manage answers 404 without the role, signed out included. No sign-in endpoints: identity comes from cab's shared session. The site keeps its own content (news, events, directory entries, the role table); people and clubs stay cab's. Before any admin exists, mix uadebate.grant gives the first role from the server. Green = the cab call behind it.
